items.text: On Shallan's first day in Lasting Integrity, Lusintia acted as her guide and was secretly told to keep watch on her. When Shallan fell from a tree, Pattern fooled Lusintia and others into fetching Stormlight, and she had to file a report after Shallan used up a whole emerald. She also accused Shallan of trying to sway Adolin's trial.
After the trial she wasn't among the first honorspren who came to bond Windrunners, but in Urithiru she was seen trailing Dabbid.

appearance.text: In Shadesmar she looks like a short woman with chin-length hair, in a stiff jacket and trousers that resemble a uniform.

personality.text: She firmly believes the honorspren are right to keep apart from humans and reveres the Herald Kalak. She has a softer side, panicking when Shallan is hurt, and like other honorspren she is easily fooled by human tricks.
